info.name: SonarQube Cloud Web authentication rules API

params.name: language
params.description: A language key; if provided, only repositories for the given language will be returned

params.name: q
params.description: A pattern to match repository keys/names against

info.name: Search for a collection of relevant rules matching a specified query. Since 5.5, following fields in the response hav...

params.name: activation
params.description: Filter rules that are activated or deactivated on the selected Quality profile. Ignored if the parameter 'qprofile' is not set.

params.name: active_severities
params.description: Comma-separated list of activation severities, i.e the severity of rules in Quality profiles.

params.name: asc
params.description: Ascending sort

params.name: available_since
params.description: Filters rules added since date. Format is yyyy-MM-dd

params.name: cleanCodeAttributeCategories
params.description: Comma-separated list of Clean Code Attribute Categories

params.name: complianceStandards
params.description: Set of compliance standards to filter on. Categories within a standard are comma-separated and behave as an 'or'. Multiple standards are separated by an ampersand and behave as an 'and'.

params.name: cwe
params.description: Comma-separated list of CWE identifiers. Use 'unknown' to select rules not associated to any CWE.

params.name: f
params.description: Comma-separated list of the fields to be returned in response. All the fields are returned by default, except actives.Since 5.5, following fields have been deprecated :"defaultDebtRemFn" becomes "defaultRemFn""debtRemFn" becomes "remFn""effortToFixDescription" becomes "gapDescription""debtOverloaded" becomes "remFnOverloaded"

params.name: facets
params.description: Comma-separated list of the facets to be computed. No facet is computed by default.

params.name: impactSeverities
params.description: Comma-separated list of Software Quality Severities

params.name: impactSoftwareQualities
params.description: Comma-separated list of Software Qualities

params.name: include_external
params.description: Include external engine rules in the results

params.name: inheritance
params.description: Comma-separated list of values of inheritance for a rule within a quality profile. Used only if the parameter 'activation' is set.

params.name: is_template
params.description: Filter template rules

params.name: languages
params.description: Comma-separated list of languages

params.name: organization
params.description: Organization key

params.name: owaspMobileTop10-2024
params.description: Comma-separated list of OWASP Mobile Top 10 (2024) lowercase categories.

params.name: owaspTop10
params.description: Comma-separated list of OWASP Top 10 lowercase categories.

params.name: owaspTop10-2021
params.description: Comma-separated list of OWASP Top 10 (2021) lowercase categories.

params.name: p
params.description: 1-based page number

params.name: ps
params.description: Page size. Must be greater than 0 and less or equal than 500

params.name: q
params.description: UTF-8 search query

params.name: qprofile
params.description: Quality profile key to filter on. Used only if the parameter 'activation' is set.

params.name: repositories
params.description: Comma-separated list of repositories

params.name: rule_key
params.description: Key of rule to search for

params.name: rule_keys
params.description: Rule keys

params.name: s
params.description: Sort field

params.name: severities
params.description: Comma-separated list of default severities. Not the same than severity of rules in Quality profiles.

params.name: sonarsourceSecurity
params.description: Comma-separated list of SonarSource security categories. Use 'others' to select rules not associated with any category

params.name: statuses
params.description: Comma-separated list of status codes

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated list of tags. Returned rules match any of the tags (OR operator)

params.name: template_key
params.description: Key of the template rule to filter on. Used to search for the custom rules based on this template.

params.name: types
params.description: Comma-separated list of types. Returned rules match any of the tags (OR operator)

info.name: Update an existing rule. Requires the 'Administer Quality Profiles' permission

params.name: debt_sub_characteristic
params.description: Debt characteristics are no more supported. This parameter is ignored.

params.name: key
params.description: Key of the rule to update

params.name: markdown_description
params.description: Rule description (mandatory for custom rule and manual rule)

params.name: markdown_note
params.description: Optional note in markdown format. Use empty value to remove current note. Note is not changed if the parameter is not set.

params.name: name
params.description: Rule name (mandatory for custom rule)

params.name: organization
params.description: Organization key

params.name: params
params.description: Parameters as semi-colon list of =, for example 'params=key1=v1;key2=v2' (Only when updating a custom rule)

params.name: remediation_fn_base_effort
params.description: Base effort of the remediation function of the rule

params.name: remediation_fn_type
params.description: Type of the remediation function of the rule

params.name: remediation_fy_gap_multiplier
params.description: Gap multiplier of the remediation function of the rule

params.name: severity
params.description: Rule severity (Only when updating a custom rule)

params.name: status
params.description: Rule status (Only when updating a custom rule)

params.name: tags
params.description: Optional comma-separated list of tags to set. Use blank value to remove current tags. Tags are not changed if the parameter is not set.

items.docs: Update an existing rule. Requires the 'Administer Quality Profiles' permission
